title: fix(app-shell): Setup → Datasources shows a refusal's details.hint under its line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB5nvWko4cKLTqouime2VKGS)_

Fixes #32305

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置 → 数据源页面在拒绝的一行短句下方显示 `details.hint`（有就显示，保留换行；没有就只显示短句）。删除时的"仍有对象绑定"分支改为读 `details.reason === 'objects_bound'`，不再把任何 400 都当成绑定拒绝。
- 为什么改：#32303 落地后，拒绝的原因和补救办法移到了 `details.hint`，而页面的 `api()` 只把 `message` 抛出来，管理员看不到怎么修。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台一个页面和它的测试，不动服务端和 spec；无提示时调用方式与原来完全一致；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` 里的 `refusalToast`、`RefusalHint` 和删除分支 `refusalReason(err) === 'objects_bound'`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/`，预期 9 个文件 67 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`:

- **The request error carries `details`.** `api()` used to throw `Error(message)` with `status` and `code` only. It now also copies the envelope's `error.details` (an object; anything else is dropped) onto `DatasourceRequestError`, so `reason`, `hint` and the fact members (`objects`, `count`, `keys`) reach the callers. Two readers, `refusalReason` and `refusalHint` (a blank hint counts as none), are the only places that look inside it.
- **Every refusal surface shows the hint.** How each one shows it:

| Surface | Door | How the hint is shown | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Load the list | `GET /datasources` | toast description | nothing else is on screen to hold it |
| Row Test (thrown) | `POST /datasources/:name/test` | toast description | the row has no inline slot; the toast already reports this |
| Row Test (`{ ok: false, error }`) | same | unchanged | the server keeps line and hint in one string there (`datasourceRefusalText`) |
| Delete | `DELETE /datasources/:name` | toast description | the confirm dialog has already closed when the refusal arrives |
| Drivers | `GET /datasources/drivers` | toast description | raised before the editor opens |
| Open for edit | `GET /datasources/:name` | toast description | the editor did not open |
| Save / create | `PATCH` / `POST /datasources` | toast description | this is where the existing pins (`externalBlock-11368`) read the refusal, and it stays where it was. The editor stays open behind it |
| Editor's Test connection (thrown) | `POST /datasources/test` | inline, under the editor's red test line | that result is already drawn inline; `assertValidConfig` refuses there with a multi-finding `invalid_config` hint |
| Sync dialog: remote tables | `GET …/remote-tables` | inline, under the dialog's `role="alert"` line, left-aligned | the refusal already replaces the table list there (objectui#13207); the toast is kept for a refusal that arrives after the dialog closed |
| Sync run | `POST …/object-draft` per table | toast description, each distinct hint once, one per line | one toast already lists every table's line |

A toast's hint goes in sonner's `description` with `descriptionClassName: 'whitespace-pre-line'`, and an inline hint is drawn in a `whitespace-pre-line` paragraph. Either way, a list refusal keeps one finding per line. With no hint, `toast.error` is called with the line alone, exactly as before, so every existing `toHaveBeenCalledWith(line)` pin still holds.

- **Delete keys on the reason.** The bound-object branch keyed on `status === 400`, which every refusal of the family answers. It now keys on `details.reason === 'objects_bound'`. Does `details.objects` make the refetch redundant? No. It carries the bound objects' names only, sorted, and the toast names them by their localized labels (`Part (part)`, `供应商 (supplier)`). So the page still reads object metadata for the labels, but only on that reason. Any other refusal, and a bound-object refusal that the read names no object for, keeps the server's line, plus its hint.
- **No text-matched branch exists elsewhere.** I grepped the page, and `external/`, for `message.includes|match|startsWith`, `.test(` against an error, and `status === 4`. The only hit was the delete branch above.

## Why

#32303 (`327ef0f8`) moved each datasource refusal's rationale and remedy from `message` into `details.hint`. The page read only `message`, so an administrator whose save, delete or sync was refused saw what was refused but not how to fix it.

## Verification

At head `b3f8f55f`:

- **Pins:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/` passes 9 files, 67 tests.
  - New in `DatasourceResourcePage.refusals-13207.test.tsx`, second describe: a refused Save toasts the line with the multi-finding `invalid_config` hint as the description, split into one finding per line. CONTROL: a refused Save with no hint calls `toast.error` with one argument. The editor's Test draws the hint inline. The Sync dialog draws the hint under the line, and CONTROL: with no hint, the line alone and no hint element. A thrown row Test toasts the hint.
  - New in `DatasourceResourcePage.deleteConfirm-13333.test.tsx`: a `code_defined` 400 while objects are bound gets the generic text plus its hint. A 400 with no `details.reason` while objects are bound gets the generic text alone.
- **Ablation:** with the page restored to `origin/main` and the new test files kept, those 6 pins fail and the other 15 tests in the two files pass.
- **Fixture:** the delete refusal fixture in `deleteConfirm-13333` now carries `details: { reason: 'objects_bound', count, objects }`, which is what `boundObjectsError` answers on `main`. The old fixture had no `details`, and the status-keyed branch never noticed. The 503 CONTROL now sends no `details`, which is the realistic shape. No other fixture changed; `refusals-13207` and `externalBlock-11368` stay green unchanged.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (src + `tsconfig.test.json`) is green.
- **Lint:** `npx eslint` on the three files gives 0 errors and 2 warnings that were already there (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` on the `load` effect).
- **Derived gates:** `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` lists 37 commands, all run under `os-verify-lock.sh`: 37 of 37 exited 0, and `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles them: "37 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". `check:type-check-debt` ran its full build in that set. The rest of CI (artifact-roster and wide-population families, `pnpm lint`, Test Core) is read from this PR's check-runs.

No translation key was added.

## Acceptance notes

- The page's other loaders (`external/` panels) show no toasts and were not in this card's Wanted. Their refusal display is outside this PR.
- A toast holding a long hint dismisses on sonner's default timer, and that includes a Save refused with a multi-finding `invalid_config` hint. The editor's Test result and the Sync dialog keep their hints inline. Moving the Save refusal inline into the editor would change where `externalBlock-11368` reads it, so it is left for a follow-up if the maintainer wants it.
